Definition: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to overcome; 1a) (Hithpolel) to be overcome; 2) to cry out, shout for joy, give a ringing cry; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exaltation, distress); 2a2) to cry aloud (in summons, exhortation of wisdom); 2b) (Piel) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exultation, praise; 2c) (Pual) ringing cry, singing out (passive); 2d) (Hiphil) to cause to ring or sing out (for joy); 2e) (Hithpolel) rejoicing (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
